projects.title: Maze Traversal
bullets: Represented maze connections using adjacency lists in Python for an individual course project.
Tested connected, disconnected, and cyclic examples as part of the maze traversal project.

projects.title: Study Planner Interface
bullets: Built a local study planner browser interface with form inputs using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS as a team project contribution.
Implemented event handling and input validation, and documented the interface and its local data flow.
